package practice

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const (
	maximumPracticeResponseBytes          int64 = 2 << 20
	maximumTeacherValidationResponseBytes int64 = 32 << 10
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

func (client Client) GetPracticeTaskContext(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskInstanceID string) (domain.PracticeTaskContext, error) {
	request, err := client.request(ctx, http.MethodGet,
		"/internal/task-instances/"+url.PathEscape(taskInstanceID)+"/teacher-context?student_id="+url.QueryEscape(studentID), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTaskContext{}, err
	}
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTaskContext{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return domain.PracticeTaskContext{}, domain.ErrStudentContextNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.PracticeTaskContext{}, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable
	}
	var result domain.PracticeTaskContext
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &result); err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTaskContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	return domain.NormalizePracticeTaskContext(result, studentID, taskInstanceID)
}

func (client Client) GetPracticeTeacherValidationContext(
	ctx context.Context,
	practice domain.PracticeTaskContext,
	learningActionID string,
) (domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext, error) {
	request, err := client.request(ctx, http.MethodGet,
		"/internal/task-instances/"+url.PathEscape(practice.TaskInstanceID)+"/teacher-validation-explanation?student_id="+url.QueryEscape(practice.StudentID), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, err
	}
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumTeacherValidationResponseBytes))
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusBadGateway || response.StatusCode == http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
			return domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		return domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable
	}
	var result domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext
	if err := decodeStrictLimited(response.Body, &result, maximumTeacherValidationResponseBytes); err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	return domain.NormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContext(result, practice, learningActionID)
}

func (client Client) RecordPracticeTaskAssistance(ctx context.Context, taskInstanceID, studentID, stepID, usageID string, action domain.TeacherAction, hintLevel *int) error {
	stepID = strings.TrimSpace(stepID)
	if stepID == "" || len(stepID) > 128 {
		return domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	kind := "TEACHER_EXPLANATION"
	switch action {
	case domain.TeacherActionGiveHint:
		kind = "HINT"
	case domain.TeacherActionAskQuestion:
		kind = "TEACHER_QUESTION"
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"usage_id": usageID, "student_id": studentID,
		"assistance": map[string]any{"schema": "practice-task-assistance-usage.v1", "step_id": stepID, "kind": kind, "hint_level": hintLevel},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request, err := client.request(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/internal/task-instances/"+url.PathEscape(taskInstanceID)+"/teacher-assistance", bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK && response.StatusCode != http.StatusCreated {
		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumPracticeResponseBytes))
		return domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable
	}
	var result struct {
		ID             string    `json:"id"`
		TaskInstanceID string    `json:"task_instance_id"`
		StudentID      string    `json:"student_id"`
		StepID         string    `json:"step_id"`
		Kind           string    `json:"kind"`
		HintLevel      *int      `json:"hint_level,omitempty"`
		PolicyVersion  string    `json:"policy_version"`
		CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	}
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &result); err != nil || result.ID != usageID ||
		result.TaskInstanceID != taskInstanceID || result.StudentID != studentID || result.StepID != stepID || result.Kind != kind ||
		result.PolicyVersion != "practice-task-assistance-policy.v1" || result.CreatedAt.IsZero() ||
		!sameHintLevel(result.HintLevel, hintLevel) {
		return domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable
	}
	_, offset := result.CreatedAt.Zone()
	if offset != 0 {
		return domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable
	}
	return nil
}

func sameHintLevel(received, requested *int) bool {
	if received == nil || requested == nil {
		return received == nil && requested == nil
	}
	return *received == *requested
}

func (client Client) request(ctx context.Context, method, path string, body io.Reader) (*http.Request, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+path, body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	return request, nil
}

func (client Client) do(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	httpClient := client.HTTPClient
	if httpClient == nil {
		httpClient = &http.Client{Timeout: 3 * time.Second}
	}
	redirectSafeClient := *httpClient
	priorCheckRedirect := httpClient.CheckRedirect
	redirectSafeClient.CheckRedirect = func(next *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
		if len(via) > 0 && !sameOrigin(via[0].URL, next.URL) {
			return http.ErrUseLastResponse
		}
		if priorCheckRedirect != nil {
			return priorCheckRedirect(next, via)
		}
		return nil
	}
	response, err := redirectSafeClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: Practice request: %v", domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable, err)
	}
	return response, nil
}

func sameOrigin(left, right *url.URL) bool {
	return left != nil && right != nil && left.Scheme == right.Scheme && left.Host == right.Host
}

func decodeStrict(reader io.Reader, target any) error {
	return decodeStrictLimited(reader, target, maximumPracticeResponseBytes)
}

func decodeStrictLimited(reader io.Reader, target any, maximumBytes int64) error {
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: reader, N: maximumBytes + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 {
		return errors.New("trailing or oversized Practice response")
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.PracticeTaskContextReader = Client{}
var _ repository.PracticeTeacherValidationContextReader = Client{}
var _ repository.PracticeTaskAssistanceRecorder = Client{}
